title: Cinema Balcony Dream
description: A woman in a magenta ornate robe stands on a stone balcony at dusk, holding a film projector that casts a beam of light. Behind her, a large curved screen tears open to reveal an opulent classical interior filled with glowing framed paintings and film reels scattered on the floor.
